question: Under federal law, must a licensed dealer provide a secure gun storage or safety device when transferring a handgun?
true_option: Yes — federal law requires dealers to include a secure storage or safety device with every handgun transfer
false_option: No — including a lock is only a voluntary industry practice
true_claim_text: dealers must include a storage or safety device with every handgun
false_claim_text: handgun locks from dealers are only a voluntary practice
source: Federal law 18 USC 922(z) (Child Safety Lock Act of 2005): a licensed importer, manufacturer, or dealer may not sell or transfer a handgun unless a secure gun storage or safety device is provided.
